messages:
sarah: Hey team — GreenCrest procurement just asked for SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 snapshot, and a pen-test letter to close the POC. They specifically asked for anything we can share from hosted vs dedicated. Timeline is ~2 weeks but buyer wants artifacts ASAP. Can we provide an attestation + what else? @mike @ashley

mike: We can supply a SOC2 summary + AOC (redacted) and the ISO cert snapshot. For pen-test: we normally provide a signed 'letter of assurance' describing that a third‑party test was performed and the high‑level scope; we don't share full raw reports publicly. Legal needs to ok exact wording. Also need scope from the customer (assets/IPs) to confirm.

ashley: For the POC staging requests — we can give a presigned S3 bundle + ephemeral staging creds (72h). If GreenCrest requires on‑prem access or VPC peering for their own red‑team, that moves this into Dedicated/Private and impacts pricing. Heads up.

rohit: From sales/procurement side, buyer is asking for "proof of ongoing vuln mgmt" and evidence for controls. Here's a minimal artifact pack we can try to deliver fast: 
- SOC2 summary + AOC letter
- ISO27001 cert snapshot
- Pen‑test attestation letter (signed)
- Last 30 days vuln scan summary (no raw customer data)
- Roles & admin access matrix (high level)
I'll start compiling if security ok's the scan output.

mike: Sounds good. Send me the scan summary (redacted) and I'll vet for sensitive findings. We need to confirm customer is OK with attestation instead of full report; if they demand full report, we require a signed NDA and legal review.

sarah: Buyer said NDA is fine — procurement will sign. I'll ask them for the exact scope/IP ranges they expect their red‑team to hit. They want artifacts by next Thu (8 days). I'll push for earlier.

ashley: Also note — if they request patch/patchdate logs or detailed infra diagrams, we typically provide a patch cadence doc and a sanitized network diagram. If they want active network testing against our hosted infra we need approvals; that tends to be the blocker. On pricing: VPC peering or dedicated capacity for testing is roughly +$10k/mo baseline (estimate).

rohit: Good call. Mike, can you draft the pen‑test attestation template we can sign and route to legal? I'll attach to the quote so procurement sees it early.

mike: Yep. I'll draft a short attestation and cc legal. ETA: EOD today. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: upload link created for initial bundle: https://files.redwood.example/presigned/greencrest-1767777777.zip (expires in 72h)

sarah: Great — I'll hold sharing until legal confirms wording. Thanks!

ashley: Quick example staging config if they ask for SSH access:
```
# staging access
user: redwood-poc
expires: 72h
allowed_source_cidr: 35.199.44.0/24
```

rohit: Action items recap:
- sarah: confirm NDA + send back requested scope/IP ranges (due tomorrow)
- mike: draft & circulate pen‑test attestation (EOD)
- ashley: prepare staging bundle + vuln scan summary (48h)
I'll add these to the SF opportunity and notify buyer on next touch. :spiral_note_pad: 

sarah: Ack — I'll update the thread as soon as procurement sends the scope. Ping me if legal wants changes to the attestation wording.
